allow: PowerShell(try { Restart-Service postgresql-x64-17 -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output "Service restarted OK" } catch { Write-Output "RESTART FAILED: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; Get-Service postgresql-x64-17 | Select-Object Name, Status)

PowerShell(foreach \($p in @\(@{Port=5432;Pid=6016},@{Port=5433;Pid=15344}\)\) { try { $proc = Get-Process -Id $p.Pid -ErrorAction Stop; $path = \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($p.Pid\)"\).ExecutablePath; Write-Output \("Port {0}: PID {1}  {2}`n         {3}" -f $p.Port,$p.Pid,$proc.ProcessName,$path\) } catch { Write-Output \("Port {0}: PID {1} not found" -f $p.Port,$p.Pid\) } })

PowerShell(foreach \($svc in 'postgresql-x64-17','postgresql-x64-18'\) { try { $spid = \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter "Name='$svc'"\).ProcessId; $port = switch \($spid\) { 6016 {'5432'} 15344 {'5433'} default {"\(pid $spid - unknown\)"} }; Write-Output \("{0}  ->  PID {1}  ->  port {2}" -f $svc, $spid, $port\) } catch { Write-Output \("{0}: error {1}" -f $svc, $_.Exception.Message\) } })
